name: Reactor Coolant Loop piping
notes: US EPR FSAR Ch 5-derived; all numerics approx (no US EPR built). Primary loop piping only: RPV and core are external (future file), PZR is external (future rcs/pzr.json, owns RCS-PRESS), SG primary side lives in rcs/sg.json, RCP in rcs/rcp.json. Tap assignments decided 2026-07-10 (all approx - FSAR does not pin them down): surge line on loop 3 HL; PZR spray from loops 2&3 CL; charging into loops 1&4 CL; single letdown tap on loop 1 XL; SI nozzles on all 4 CLs plus LHSI hot-leg injection for long-term recirculation. Th/Tc/flow indicators placed on SICS as hardwired backups; primary presentation is PICS trend displays (deferred phase).

devices.name: Reactor coolant loop {n} hot leg (RCS{n}-HL)
devices.behavior: Hot leg pipe: RPV outlet nozzle to SG{n} inlet plenum, carries full loop flow at Th. Loop 3 hot leg carries the pressurizer surge line tap. 'leak' = primary leak inside containment (size in casualty params); 'break' = large hot-leg LOCA. Casualty-injection states only - no operator action changes them.

devices.name: Reactor coolant loop {n} crossover leg (RCS{n}-XL)
devices.behavior: Crossover leg: SG{n} outlet plenum down to RCP{n} suction. Lowest point of the loop (loop seal) - matters for small-break LOCA behavior. Carries the loop flow elbow taps (RCS{n}-FE) and, on loop 1, the CVCS letdown tap. 'break' = pump-suction LOCA.

devices.name: Reactor coolant loop {n} cold leg (RCS{n}-CL)
devices.behavior: Cold leg: RCP{n} discharge to RPV inlet nozzle at Tc. Busiest segment for taps: SI nozzle (all loops), charging nozzle (loops 1&4), PZR spray tap (loops 2&3). 'break' = cold-leg LOCA (design-basis large break).

devices.name: Loop {n} hot leg temperature elements (RCS{n}-TH-RTD)
devices.behavior: Hot leg RTDs in thermowells near the SG inlet. SIMPLIFICATION: one device stands for the full narrow-range + wide-range set. Feeds RCS{n}-TH; used by Tavg/DT derivations and (future) RPS/RCSL.

devices.name: Loop {n} cold leg temperature elements (RCS{n}-TC-RTD)
devices.behavior: Cold leg RTDs downstream of the RCP discharge. SIMPLIFICATION: one device for the NR+WR set. Feeds RCS{n}-TC.

devices.name: Loop {n} flow element - crossover leg elbow taps (RCS{n}-FE)
devices.behavior: Elbow-tap differential-pressure loop flow measurement on the crossover leg (placement approx - Westinghouse-style convention). Feeds RCS{n}-FLOW; low loop flow is a (future) RPS reactor trip input, 2-of-4 loops.

signals.name: Loop {n} low flow (derived)
signals.notes: Trip-grade use (2/4 loops -> reactor trip) belongs to the future RPS file; here it drives the annunciator only. Threshold approx.

control.notes: SICS hardwired backup; PICS trends are the primary display (deferred). GE-general-gauge model available.
